invariants.rationale: The method immediately accesses font.getData(), so font is expected to be non-null.
selection.draw() is called, so selection must be non-null.
batch is passed to selection.draw(), so it must be non-null.
x is used as a graphical coordinate in draw operations, commonly non-negative in UI layouts.
y is used as a graphical coordinate in draw operations, commonly non-negative in UI layouts.
